tasks.natural_request: In scripts/external_inference_audit.py, make number accept only finite real numeric values and finite numeric strings. It must return 0.0 for booleans, NaN, positive or negative infinity, invalid strings, and non-numeric objects, while preserving finite integers, floats, decimal strings, and scientific-notation strings. Add focused external-inference audit tests.

In scripts/hive_fleet_readiness.py, when remote tasks are enabled and no trusted remote node is visible, treat a relay URL as satisfying private connectivity only when it is a syntactically valid HTTPS URL with a nonempty hostname and no embedded username, password, or fragment. Empty, malformed, HTTP, credential-bearing, and fragment-bearing relay values must retain the same_lan_or_private_tunnel_required_without_relay blocker. Preserve behavior when a trusted remote node exists or remote tasks are disabled. Add focused fleet-readiness tests.

In scripts/self_evolution_governor.py, make active_frontier ignore frontier rows whose residual is a boolean, malformed, or non-finite; compare only finite numeric residuals, including numeric strings; return an empty dict when no valid frontier remains; and break equal-residual ties deterministically by ascending benchmark_name and then ascending best_report instead of input order. Preserve preferred-family and preferred-card filtering before global fallback. Add focused self-evolution governor tests.
